universe: existing cached TOP_100 disclosure universe; no 2026
feature_sources: cached disclosure metadata and primary public SEC/issuer sources only; numerical facts retained; inaccessible sources excluded
comparison: Current 2025 performance-linked executive compensation amendment or recurring program compared to same issuer same program in 2024; explicit in-year amendments may compare original terms quoted in current primary source.
event_rule: Primary source establishes a lower numeric performance hurdle at the SAME payout tier, same metric, measurement duration and comparable units; OR explicitly waives/removes an existing cashflow/ROIC/earnings hurdle for previously granted award without replacing it with equally binding condition. Require actual terms, not generic discretion authority.
score: Relative decrease in positive comparable target expressed percent; explicit hurdle removal scored 100 with kind categorical. No economic inference from score magnitude between kinds.
control_rule: Both old/new comparable terms are verified and all observed relevant performance hurdles unchanged or stricter; no unverified material hurdle.
exclusions: generic new plan or discretionary authority
confidential numeric targets or missing prior terms
higher payout explained by actual better realized performance
ambiguous offsets or changed business scope
screening: Exhaustively classify every cached executive_compensation_change filing; full-source review for performance/metric/target/hurdle/goal/amend/modify/waiv/reduc/adjust language and paired issuer programs; descriptive screening only
holdout: No return or price lookup; root performs predeclared central pricing
